name: PANORAMA public set (pancreas CE-CT)
what: PANORAMA's public set of contrast-enhanced pancreas CT, 2,238 scans of 2,224 patient ids, from Zenodo records 13715870, 13742336, 11034011 and 10999754; tier 1 of the anomaly harvest: its four image batches fetched, of which the data platform counts 2,024 CTs so far, and 1,950 subjects qualifying, about 194.2 GB in the source's catalogue (NIfTI); 274 of its MSD and NIH cases are inside AbdomenAtlas 3.0 Mini, and one of its CTs is the same voxels as one of the kidney thorax-abdomen set's
level_truth: the data platform records no level labels from the release; its own automatic level calls, which no radiologist has read, are kept apart under its anomaly_harvest folder

segmentations.masks: not recorded: the fetch took the four image batches alone
vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

how_to_get: spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh zenodo --collection panorama --record 13715870 13742336 11034011 10999754 --include '^batch_[1-4]\.zip$', submitted from the harvest's acquisition folder; the check is FETCH_STATUS.json's unresolved_failures at 0, and, by the manifest's note, 4 zips by md5 and 2,238 _0000.nii.gz volumes to verify.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid panorama; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="panorama",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
